postal_system.legal_rule: The UPU Bhutan addressing sheet places five digits to the right of the locality and describes the first digit as Dzongdey postal region, second as Dzongkhag, third as Dungkhag and last two as delivery area. Bhutan Post publishes Dzongkhag, Gewog, Post Office and Postal Code locator fields. These establish syntax, address order and routing semantics, not canonical polygons, civic addresses, building relations, current completeness or blanket redistribution rights.
postal_system.assignment_rule: Every postcode is stored as a five-character text value so leading zeroes remain syntactically possible. A production assignment requires an exact Bhutan Post locator row with its Dzongkhag, Gewog, Post Office, retrieval time and source digest pinned. UPU digit meanings, equal prefixes, names, office points, coordinates, administrative overlap or nearest features do not create a postal area or prove delivery to an address.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No reviewed canonical national Bhutan postcode polygon artifact is bundled. Official geometry requires an exact Bhutan Post-authorized boundary artifact and code relation with authority, edition, coverage, rights, CRS, topology and digest pinned. A mathematical, Voronoi, interpolated or model-generated delivery surface remains derived and uncertainty-bearing; UPU digit groups, locator rows, NLCS administrative or cadastral maps, NSB enumeration areas, eSakor records and OSM never become official postcode polygons.
postal_system.address_rule: Organization, house or building, flat or apartment or shop, street or Lam, village or urban zone, Gewog or Thromde, Dzongkhag, post office or community mail office, P.O. box and five-digit postcode remain typed. A postcode row, administrative name, census structure, parcel, Thram, coordinate or map label alone does not identify a recipient, owner, occupant, entrance, unit or exact civic address.
postal_system.building_rule: Exact building display requires a rights-cleared civic-address point or stable address identifier, separately permitted building geometry, and a source-defined stable relation, common identifier or reviewed explicit crosswalk. NLCS topography, cadastral parcels and eSakor transactions and NSB census structures are candidates or validation evidence only; containment, text match, coordinate equality, proximity and nearest-building logic never establish the exact address-building relation.
postal_system.licence_rule: Bhutan Post public pages and UPU materials are reference evidence only until exact reuse terms are recorded. NLCS topographic and administrative products may require application, approval, payment and use agreements, while cadastral maps are not public. NSB statistical and eSakor land, flat and building records have confidentiality, access and personal-data constraints. Portal visibility, payment, login or access never grants blanket redistribution rights.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Recipients, senders, P.O. box holders, tracking and query records, citizenship and NDI identifiers, permanent addresses, biometrics, transaction parties, witnesses, consent records, Thrams, plot interests, owners, occupants, tenants, households and census microdata are excluded from public artifacts. Only explicitly public or licensed non-personal fields may enter a production pack.
